name: Revenue
definition: Total revenue. Banks: net interest income + non-interest income when no total revenue is tagged.

name: Cost of revenue
definition: Cost of goods and services sold, including depreciation where the company includes it.

name: Gross profit
definition: Reported gross profit; otherwise revenue minus cost of revenue.

name: Operating income
definition: Operating income (loss). Not reported by most banks and insurers.

name: Net income
definition: Net income (loss) attributable to the parent company's shareholders.

name: Diluted EPS
definition: Diluted earnings per share. Never derived: quarterly EPS cannot be subtracted.

name: Diluted shares
definition: Weighted average diluted shares outstanding. Never derived.

name: R&D expense
definition: Research and development expense.

name: SG&A expense
definition: Selling, general and administrative expense.

name: Total assets
definition: Total assets at period end.

name: Total liabilities
definition: Reported total liabilities; otherwise liabilities-and-equity minus total equity (incl. NCI) minus temporary equity.

name: Shareholders' equity
definition: Equity attributable to the parent company (excludes non-controlling interests).

name: Cash and equivalents
definition: Cash and cash equivalents; excludes restricted cash where the company separates it.

name: Long-term debt
definition: Long-term debt including current maturities. Excludes short-term borrowings and commercial paper.

name: Operating cash flow
definition: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities.

name: Capital expenditure
definition: Payments to acquire property, plant and equipment (a positive number).

name: Dividends paid
definition: Cash dividends paid (a positive number).

name: Free cash flow
definition: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditure.

name: Gross margin
definition: Gross profit / revenue.

name: Operating margin
definition: Operating income / revenue.

name: Net margin
definition: Net income / revenue.

name: Liabilities and equity (helper)
definition: Balance-sheet total; used to derive total liabilities.

name: Equity incl. NCI (helper)
definition: Total equity including non-controlling interests.

name: Non-controlling interest (helper)
definition: Non-controlling interest in equity.

name: Temporary equity (helper)
definition: Redeemable / mezzanine equity outside both liabilities and equity.

name: Long-term debt non-current (helper)
definition: Non-current portion of long-term debt.

name: Long-term debt current (helper)
definition: Current maturities of long-term debt.

name: Net interest income (helper)
definition: Banks: interest income minus interest expense.

name: Non-interest income (helper)
definition: Banks: fees, trading and other non-interest income.

name: Net income incl. NCI (helper)
definition: ProfitLoss; used to derive net_income.

name: Net income to NCI (helper)
definition: Net income attributable to non-controlling interests.

name: Liabilities + temporary equity (helper)
definition: Liabilities-and-equity minus equity incl. NCI; step towards total liabilities.
